let go verb

also release, let go of

classical

dīmitte

let go!

A short composed prompt; the object of dīmitte comes from the scene.

Other words

  • dīmittō, dīmittere, dīmīsī, dīmissum — let go of, release

    verb, third conjugation · classical

Examples

  • Hanc ansam dīmitte.

    Let go of this hold: use only when releasing that particular hold is intended.composed

See also hold on, grasp, let me go!.
